label: Normal flow
description: Typical off-peak weekday: moderate demand, clear weather, buses every 6 minutes, ~3 emergency calls per 30 minutes.

label: Rush hour
description: Morning peak: demand ramps up to ~1.5x normal mid-episode, heavier eastbound flow on the Street 2 corridor, crowded buses.

label: Incident / blockage
description: A crash blocks two of three eastbound lanes on Street 2 just before J5 from minute 5 to minute 25 (capacity -75 %); extra emergency vehicles respond.

label: Rain
description: Rain: saturation flow -6 %, speeds -10 %, crash risk x1.71, fewer pedestrians.

label: Sandstorm
description: Sandstorm (shamal): visibility-driven capacity loss -12 %, speeds -20 %, crash risk x2.0, few pedestrians, 15 % of trips cancelled.

label: Public event surge
description: An arena event ends at minute 8: a surge of cars leaves from the east side (J6/J9) and thousands of pedestrians cross at J5, J6 and J9.

label: Bus-priority corridor
description: Street 2 runs a bus every 3 minutes in a dedicated bus lane with transit signal priority available; high passenger demand.
